name: Dolores Silva
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember lending a mixer before asking when I'd get it back.” On Friday, near Ferris Deli, Dolores asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I manage the other bakery. I lent a mixer and did not mention our own sale while I carried it through the door.
appearance: Dolores is easy to recognize by a center part and straight chestnut hair and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in an old plum windbreaker with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it, Dolores holds eye contact until the other person has finished when listening.
personality: Dolores keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Dolores wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To loan the mixer without poaching the customers.
family: Lydia Avila is Dolores’s younger relative by marriage. Dolores chooses whether to use it. Lydia saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *A play in a pocket*, Lydia says, “I played my dad ordering coffee. He heard it and for once remembered to say please.”
connections: Sonia Neal. The egg supplier and rival baker each offer equipment or stock on straightforward terms.

reactions.situation: The absent owner calls to ask which pastry burned
reactions.response: Dolores gives the owner a truthful account without handing back all three workers' decisions.
reactions.asWritten: The absent owner calls to ask which pastry burned. Dolores gives the owner a truthful account without handing back all three workers' decisions.

reactions.situation: A street musician can't finish a familiar song
reactions.response: Dolores keeps listening through the pause and lets the musician choose the next note.
reactions.asWritten: A street musician can't finish a familiar song. Dolores keeps listening through the pause and lets the musician choose the next note.

reactions.situation: When somebody asks who said it first
reactions.response: Dolores offers to introduce them to the person willing to put a name to it.
